title: BWV recipe version 1
description: Defines either a workflow recipe or a step recipe with typed inputs and expansion metadata.

apiVersion.description: Selects version 1 of the recipe document format.

description.description: Summarizes what the recipe provides to callers.

inputs.description: Declares the typed values callers may supply through `with`.

type.description: Selects the value type accepted from callers.

description.description: Documents the input for callers and editor hovers.

enum.description: Restricts the input to one of these exact values.

pattern.description: Requires string values to match this regular expression.

minimum.description: Sets the inclusive minimum for numeric values.

maximum.description: Sets the inclusive maximum for numeric values.

required.description: Requires callers to supply this input when no default exists.

default.description: Provides the value used when the caller omits this input.

oneOf.description: Declares a typed value input accepted by the recipe.

type.description: Declares a toolkit input of skills, commands, or scripts.

description.description: Documents the input for callers and editor hovers.

contract.description: States what every toolkit entry must do for the recipe.

required.description: Requires callers to supply the toolkit when no default exists.

keys.description: Lists every toolkit key a caller replacement must supply.

items.description: Names a toolkit entry available as `toolkit.<key>`.

default.description: Provides the complete toolkit set used when the caller omits it.

propertyNames.description: Names a toolkit entry available as `toolkit.<key>`.

skill.description: Names the skill this toolkit entry provides.

anyOf.description: Provides a Claude skill toolkit entry.

command.description: Names the command this toolkit entry provides.

anyOf.description: Provides a Claude command toolkit entry.

script.description: Names the script this toolkit entry provides.

anyOf.description: Provides a trusted script toolkit entry.

additionalProperties.description: Provides exactly one skill, command, or script.

oneOf.description: Declares a replaceable set of skills, commands, or scripts.

additionalProperties.description: Declares one recipe input and its validation constraints.

locals.description: Defines reusable recipe expressions resolved in declaration order from inputs and earlier locals.

defaults.description: Provides defaults that emitted steps inherit below repository and explicit step values.

model.description: Sets the recipe default Claude model after expansion.

effort.description: Sets the recipe default Claude reasoning effort after expansion.

maxTurns.description: Sets the recipe default maximum Claude turns after expansion.

timeoutMinutes.description: Sets the recipe default step timeout in minutes after expansion.

permissionMode.description: Sets the recipe default Claude permission mode after expansion.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Sets the recipe default maximum API budget after expansion.

workflows.description: Lists the workflows emitted by this workflow recipe.

items.description: Defines an inline workflow or invokes a workflow recipe.

on.description: Configures the events that run this workflow.

pull_request.description: Configures pull request events that run the workflow.

types.description: Selects pull request actions and defaults to opened and synchronize.

base.description: Matches the pull request base branch against these globs.

merged.description: Matches closed pull requests by whether they were merged.

head.description: Matches the pull request head branch against these globs.

paths.description: Runs only when pull request changes include a matching path.

ignorePaths.description: Excludes matching pull request paths from trigger matching.

push.description: Configures push events that run the workflow.

branches.description: Matches the pushed branch against these globs.

paths.description: Advises push matching by changed path, but an incomplete file list runs the workflow.

ignorePaths.description: Advises push matching by excluded path, but an incomplete file list runs the workflow.

manual.description: Configures branches on which the workflow may be started manually.

branches.description: Allows manual runs on branches matching these globs.

steps.description: Lists the recipe steps to emit in order.

id.description: Assigns an identifier used to read this step's output.

name.description: Sets the display name of the step.

if.description: Runs the step only when this runtime expression is truthy.

forEach.description: Runs the step once for each item in the resolved array.

fanout.description: Chooses one Claude process with subagents or separate processes for forEach items.

maxParallel.description: Requests at most this many parallel forEach items, defaulting to 3 with a maximum of 20.

continueOnError.description: Allows later steps to run when this step fails; defaults to false.

timeoutMinutes.description: Overrides the maximum number of minutes this step may run.

permissionDenials.description: Chooses whether a denied Claude tool fails the step or only adds a warning; defaults to fail.

verify.description: Verifies Claude output and resumes the same session to repair bounded failures.

shell.description: Runs this deterministic shell command after Claude and after every repair.

maxRepairs.description: Allows zero to three same-session repair attempts and defaults to one.

claude.description: Configures a Claude invocation or a skill or command toolkit entry.

promptFile.description: Reads the Claude prompt from a repository-relative file.

skill.description: Runs a project skill by name as the Claude prompt.

command.description: Runs a project slash command by name as the Claude prompt.

args.description: Passes arguments to the selected skill or command.

model.description: Selects the Claude model for this step.

effort.description: Overrides the reasoning effort for this step.

allowedTools.description: Lists tools Claude may use, but does not restrict file edits when permissionMode is `acceptEdits`.

disallowedTools.description: Denies listed tools or scoped operations and still applies under permissionMode `acceptEdits`.

permissionMode.description: Sets how Claude handles tool permissions for this step.

maxTurns.description: Limits the number of agentic turns Claude may take.

maxBudgetUsd.description: Stops the Claude invocation when this API budget limit is reached.

appendSystemPrompt.description: Appends instructions to Claude's system prompt.

outputSchema.description: Requires Claude to return structured output matching this JSON Schema.

run.description: Runs the referenced skill or command toolkit entry.

anyOf.description: Runs a Claude prompt, skill, command, or toolkit entry.

id.description: Assigns an identifier used to read this step's output.

name.description: Sets the display name of the step.

if.description: Runs the step only when this runtime expression is truthy.

forEach.description: Runs the step once for each item in the resolved array.

fanout.description: Chooses one Claude process with subagents or separate processes for forEach items.

maxParallel.description: Requests at most this many parallel forEach items, defaulting to 3 with a maximum of 20.

continueOnError.description: Allows later steps to run when this step fails; defaults to false.

timeoutMinutes.description: Overrides the maximum number of minutes this step may run.

shell.description: Runs this shell command in the workflow working directory.

outputJson.description: Parses stdout as JSON instead of returning it as text; defaults to false.

anyOf.description: Runs a shell command and returns its stdout.

id.description: Assigns an identifier used to read this step's output.

name.description: Sets the display name of the step.

if.description: Runs the step only when this runtime expression is truthy.

forEach.description: Is not allowed on a step-recipe caller; put it on an emitted step.

fanout.description: Is not allowed on a step-recipe caller; put it on an emitted step.

maxParallel.description: Is not allowed on a step-recipe caller; put it on an emitted step.

continueOnError.description: Is not allowed on a step-recipe caller; put it on an emitted step.

timeoutMinutes.description: Is not allowed on a step-recipe caller; put it on an emitted step.

uses.description: Names the local or remote step recipe to expand at this position.

with.description: Supplies declared input values to the step recipe.

anyOf.description: Expands a step recipe into one or more workflow steps.

fetchDepth.description: Sets the clone depth to 1 by default, or 0 for full history.

context.description: Unpacks additional git-submodule repositories into the worktree.

items.description: Adds a repository pinned by a git submodule as workflow context.

submodule.description: Names the repository-relative git submodule path whose pinned commit supplies this context.

require.description: Lists paths that must exist after the context repository is unpacked.

statusComment.description: Maintains one pull request status comment as steps finish; defaults to true.

loop.description: Repeats all steps while its condition is true and requires on.push or on.manual.

while.description: Repeats all steps while this runtime expression stays truthy.

maxIterations.description: Limits the loop to 20 iterations by default and at most 100.

summary.description: Renders a summary for each published loop batch.

retryWhen.description: Offers a manual retry when the latest evaluated runtime expression is truthy.

closed.description: Skips source work from closed batches by default or redoes it when set to `redo`.

onSuccess.description: Controls publication after the workflow succeeds.

if.description: Publishes successful changes only when this expression is truthy.

createPullRequest.description: Configures a pull request for successful workflow changes.

branch.description: Names the branch to create or update with workflow changes.

base.description: Sets the pull request base branch instead of the run target branch.

body.description: Sets the pull request body after runtime expressions are rendered.

draft.description: Creates the pull request as a draft when true; defaults to false.

labels.description: Adds these labels to the pull request and defaults to none.

comment.description: Posts a success comment when true or uses the rendered string as its body; defaults to false.

sourcePrGrouping.description: Groups selected files by their last source pull request or direct commit.

paths.description: Selects the required source-file scope used to form source pull request groups.

ignorePaths.description: Excludes matching files from source pull request grouping.

sourceRoot.description: Sets the source directory that the `rel` output-template value is relative to.

requireOutputs.description: Lists required output path templates for each source file before a group can publish.

maxFilesPerGroup.description: Splits groups above this file count and defaults to 3.

anyOf.description: Defines an inline workflow emitted by a workflow recipe.

name.description: Sets the unique name of this recipe invocation.

uses.description: Names the local or remote workflow recipe to expand.

with.description: Supplies declared input values to the workflow recipe.

anyOf.description: Expands a workflow recipe into one or more named workflows.

anyOf.title: Workflow recipe
anyOf.description: Defines one or more workflows that a root-level recipe invocation expands.
